date_scope_check.qualification_retained: This is an announced restriction for Iraqi-residency holders departing northeast Syria toward Iraqi Kurdistan after the last permitted day, September 6, 2020. Its intended start is September 7, not the September 2 publication date. Actual initial enforcement remains unverified. The September 15 schedule for European-residency, medical and marriage cases does not restore this specific cohort. A November 29 report quotes a crossing-administration official describing permission for Iraqi-residency holders to depart on Sundays, Tuesdays and Thursdays. This establishes that the announced blanket exclusion no longer applied by November 29; the first day of restored permission, individual passage and uninterrupted earlier enforcement remain unknown. Restrictions on merchants and other cohorts are separate.
